subtitles.en: are compellingly priced or not. Kate joins us now for more. Kate, good morning.
subtitles.zh: 是否定价具有吸引力。Kate现在加入我们了解更多。Kate，早上好。

subtitles.en: Yeah, good morning. How well priced do you think we are now? I think we could have a little bit more volatility over the course of the next few weeks.
subtitles.zh: 是的，早上好。你认为我们现在定价有多合理？我认为未来几周可能还会有一些波动。

subtitles.en: I mean, I'm not ready to call an all-clear, but I think we go back to our process, which is centered on macro fundamentals, then positioning sentiment and technicals,
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，我还不准备宣布一切明朗，但我认为我们回归流程，聚焦宏观基本面，然后定位情绪和技术面，

subtitles.en: and finally, then, on valuations. And everything we're seeing in terms of the macro data, the high-frequency in the US, the data that we're cobbling together from third parties,
subtitles.zh: 最后是估值。我们从宏观数据中看到的一切，美国的高频数据，我们从第三方收集的数据，

subtitles.en: the fundamental data all looks really strong. The place that there's a huge amount of weakness of course is the sentiment and the technicals. And so, it's our view that most of this has been a
subtitles.zh: 基本面数据看起来都非常强劲。当然，疲软之处在于情绪和技术面。因此，我们认为大部分是

subtitles.en: technical resetting that doesn't mean it's necessarily over yet. But if you are a medium-term investor, like a lot of city wealth clients are, this is an interesting time if you have been under-risk
subtitles.zh: 技术性重估，这并不意味着一定结束。但如果你是中期市场参与者，像许多花旗财富客户一样，如果你一直风险敞口不足

subtitles.en: and overweight cash to think about kind of averaging in. Like, in our portfolios, the core multi-ass portfolios, we've been overweight equities all throughout this year.
subtitles.zh: 且现金超配，现在考虑平均买入是个有趣时机。比如在我们的**组合中，核心多资产组合，我们全年一直超配权益资产。

subtitles.en: And I don't see anything that's leading me to cut back my equity exposure at this point.
subtitles.zh: 目前我看不到任何让我减少权益资产敞口的理由。

subtitles.en: So, isn't it uncomfortable? Yeah, of course. Do I like it? Not really. That said, this is normal, and this is part of like an overall market functioning. And we're going to wait it out.

clip_research.source_claim: Kate Moore称当前市场回调主要是“技术性重置”（估值重置），宏观基本面数据依然强劲，她不会削减股票敞口，并称“我们会等它过去”。
clip_research.public_baseline: 公开报道显示凯特·摩尔此前多次警告市场情绪过度乐观、投资者低估风险，并预计全球股市大涨后将进入盘整期。
clip_research.surprise_gap: 她一边承认情绪与技术面“极度疲弱”、不宣布警报解除，一边维持全年超配股票且不削减敞口——谨慎措辞与坚定仓位并存，构成可用的“言行对照”张力，但尚无证据表明其仓位与表态矛盾。
